subject: Re: Project Saffron — LRB decision
body:
Team,

Decision for the 07-06 Launch Review Board pre-read, agreed with Nadia today:

1) Project Saffron ships with 7b-mt-bt as the primary serving model; 10.7b-mt goes behind the quality-critical flag exactly per Carmen's recommendation.
2) The 17 languages on Yara's audit-artifact exclusion list are out of the external demo and documented as a known limitation. Privacy review already signed off on the remaining set.
3) Scope cut: the 8B LM does not ship in this window. It stays research-only until we have a separate eval story — I've moved it to the Q3 backlog.

Milan, please have the staging endpoint frozen by 07-03 so LRB sees exactly what would ship.

Nice work everyone — Saffron is in good shape going into review.

Priya
